description:
receive do after 10 -> IO.puts("t") end (no message clauses) fails on interp, run and build with error[internal/post-resolution-leftover]: quoted function decode failed: invalid any value ref: ExpectedTag { expected: ValueKind(1), found: ValueKind(3) }, at <generated>. Reproduces on ad21e1635 and ed7568bd9. A receive with at least one clause plus after works (fixture 00243). Elixir accepts the after-only form; it is the idiomatic sleep. Find which quoted-function decode expects a list where the after-only form supplies something else, fix it at its source, and add an oracle fixture on all three paths.

Still reproduces (Callables, 2026-11-21) on develop 49e06fe93, interp and run, and on #836: receive do after 20 -> :ok end fails at compile time with error[internal/post-resolution-leftover]: quoted function decode failed: invalid any value ref: ExpectedTag { expected: ValueKind(1), found: ValueKind(3) }. Elixir returns :ok after 20 ms. Probe: Callables' scratchpad 44.6/bare.fz.
title: A receive with only an after clause compiles
